snippet.title: Coin Harvest – Launch Trailer | An Idle Coin Pusher for Your Desktop
snippet.description:
Coin Harvest is out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4381180/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch_trailer
An idle coin pusher that lives on your desktop. Pour coins onto the plateau, upgrade the robot arms that sweep them off, and climb ten realms with their own coins and rules. The pile keeps paying while you work.

🪙 Get it on Steam (20% off in launch week): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4381180/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch_trailer
🎮 Free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4397980/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch_trailer
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/rjGETAhs6B

What's inside
• Lives on your desktop as a small window that can stay on top, or goes fullscreen
• Real coin physics: every coin piles up, tumbles and spills over the edge
• Six islands in every realm, each with a robot arm you upgrade
• Ten realms, each with its own coin and its own rule, from Brass to the Casino (with Pumpkin, Snowfall and Tropic on the way)
• Ascend for crystals and spend them on permanent upgrades
• Golden coins, coin storms and a coin catalog to complete
• Playable in 30 languages
